purpose: Keep LINE Login identity comparable with Messaging API group identities.
requirements: The contract LIFF app and the runtime Messaging API channel belong to the same LINE Developers provider.
The LIFF app uses the exact production contract-signing HTTPS endpoint.
The LIFF app requests only openid and profile for this flow.
The runtime continues to verify current membership against the contract-bound group.
Only the designated signer may submit identity documents or a signature.
forbidden: Committing production channel IDs, LIFF IDs, group IDs, user IDs, or tokens
Treating a stored member name as proof of current membership
productionEvidence: Provider alignment inspected in LINE Developers Console
Project-local LIFF environment value deployed without committing it
Known non-signer group member reached read-only contract access
No invitation, signature, contract transition, or LINE message was created by verification
